_comment: validateBlock('chart', spec) vectors for the Vega-Lite subset (DISPLAY-PROTOCOL-v0 §5.2). 'valid' must pass; 'invalid' must be refused with the stated code at the stated path (paths start at the Show input root). Row, cell and series limits are generated in the test.

valid.name: a pie: arc with theta and colour
a donut: innerRadius, 12 slices, and its labels
pareto: bars and a cumulative line through window
point selection and a param condition
errorband under a line, data inherited by the layers
a layer with its own inline data (a rule)
axis, legend, scale, sort, bin, title object and resolve, all within the allowlist
an interval selection on x with its fields
median, q1 and q3 over the whole partition
an interval computed upstream: an errorband over low and high fields, and a line
sort by a channel, by a field with an order, by an encoding; a value condition
a moving average over a small frame, and a cumulative sum
$schema, config and usermeta at the top are stripped, not refused

invalid.name: a protocol-relative URL in a title
a data: URI in a mark property
a pie of 13 rows with no colour (each row a slice)
a pie whose colour a window writes, over 13 rows (review R7: counted as its rows)
a pie of 3 colours by 5 details (15 slices)
a donut's innerRadius out of range
a test string in a condition
an expr in a mark property
an expr hidden under a legend's values
a param that is not a selection
a view with both mark and layer
an encoding names a field the data lacks
a nested value in a row
config inside a layer is not stripped, it is unknown there
the spec has an unknown field
review 1c: a toggle expression on a selection
review 1d: an event-stream filter on a selection
review 1e: a lookup hidden behind a window op key
a transform with two op keys
an unknown key beside a transform's op
review 1f: maxbins 1e9 in a bin transform
review 1g: a custom formatType on a channel
review 1g: a custom formatType on an axis
review 1g: an unknown key on a mark
review 1g: an unknown key on a channel
review 1g: an unknown key on a param
an unknown key on a scale
an unknown key on a sort
an unknown key in a predicate
an unknown key in an aggregate op
an unknown key on the title
a selection with an unknown key
a predicate filter field the data lacks
UI review R2: a sliding median
q3 on a frame open at one end
cut: ci0 as a channel aggregate
cut: ci1 in an aggregate transform
cut: an errorband with extent ci
cut: an errorbar with extent ci
cut: a sort with an op
cut: a condition with a field
a series named twice in series_order
